title: BC Code Intelligence: Your New VS Code AI Development Partner
summary: BC Code Intelligence is a VS Code extension that brings Business Central-specific AI development guidance through 14 domain experts, structured workflows, and 100+ curated knowledge topics to help developers solve problems faster and follow best practices.
key_points: Provides BC-specific guidance from 14 specialized AI experts covering architecture, coding, debugging, testing, security, and integration
Offers structured development methodologies for common tasks like code optimization, architecture reviews, security audits, and version upgrades
Includes 100+ curated knowledge topics based on ALGuidelines and community-validated BC patterns
Supports organizational customization with company, team, and project-level knowledge layering
Installs with one click into VS Code with zero configuration required

quotes.text: BC Code Intelligence is our approach to bringing comprehensive BC development intelligence directly into your VS Code workflow.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core value proposition: integrated, BC-specific AI guidance without leaving the development environment

quotes.text: Instead of generic AI responses about "database operations," you get specific guidance on Item Ledger Entry posting patterns and other BC-specific challenges.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how BC Code Intelligence differs from generic AI by providing Business Central domain expertise
